test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) JN-IM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47b371f043fe345102cc6156cbce969e664c83a07354b7a35f4cba1c59bf083e.png] 

Option 2) RV-QU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b80ac3a10498b45ab23f5f3a88d0e447255be7d973ee8aa9dd2e12150630a97a.png] 

Option 3) PT-OS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/617dfff0718e70472aee8e9645438cad9b677afda5f279fccc946dbe6dd5488b.png] 

Option 4) MQ-LO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83b8acaac50113e423fe9675a6fa2aa66bd8aed525c37b9183e091ec144af18f.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'MQ-LO' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
